inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: H1 FY2026 interim note 12(b) weighted average for diluted EPS, 1,067.602m (1,061.846m basic + 5.756m share-option adjustment); shares in issue at 30-Jun-2026 1,061.9m (share capital HK$106.188m at HK$0.10 par). Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows. 34.9m options remain issuable under the scheme.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 interest income HK$16.8m (interest received HK$12.6m). Under HKFRS PAX classifies interest received in INVESTING activities, so reported OCF/FCF already excludes it and no deduction is made to last_fcf. Interest income does sit inside segment EBITDA (other income); the forward EBITDA-margin paths are set ~0.3pp below the reported history to strip it, so the HK$4.08bn cash pile is counted once, in the bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: Annual report cash-flow / note 25(b) share-based payment expense: FY2019 38.7, FY2020 38.8, FY2021 13.7, FY2022 0, FY2023 0, FY2024 31.7, FY2025 0 (HK$m). Grants are lumpy option awards; no equity-award tax withholding (EquityAwardTaxes 0 all years). Forward SBC charged at the 2018-2025 average, ~0.3% of revenue, rather than the FY2025 zero.
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 HK$9.9m, H1 FY2026 nil (FY2020-23 HK$69-87m/yr). Effectively a non-repurchaser now; the flat count is a modelling convention paid for by the SBC charge, not by buybacks.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z regular close (HKEX), Yahoo Finance chart API
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are HKD (pegged to USD); revenue is global and largely USD/EUR-invoiced. Unlevered (no borrowings). Cost of equity = 4.0% HKD/USD long risk-free + 1.0 beta x 5.5% ERP = 9.5%. No extra premium for China-manufacturing, governance or memory-cost risk: those are charged in the scenario flows and weights (adaptations 7f), and WACC is identical across scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A) leases as debt: lease liabilities HK$58.0m (45.5 non-current + 12.5 current, 30-Jun-2026) are in total_debt; lease principal (HK$17.6m FY2025) is NOT deducted from the flows; right-of-use depreciation sits in D&A and lease renewal is charged through capex (capex path carries ~0.3pp of revenue for ROU renewal). EBITDA is post-IFRS-16.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100%); NCI stock of HK$38.0m (30-Jun-2026) deducted once in the equity bridge. NCI share of profit is immaterial (HK$2.6m FY2025, HK$0.6m H1 FY2026), so modelled NOPAT ties to attributable profit within noise.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, with the non-US adaptations (HKD WACC, lease treatment A, NCI in bridge, non-operating assets in bridge). Routed per dcf-methods SKILL.md: PAX is an operating hardware + SaaS manufacturer (POS terminals, MAXSTORE), not a bank/REIT/LIC/holdco; no prior valuation or memory entry exists. Hi Sun Technology holds 34.28% (largest shareholder, related-party board overlap) - an associate relationship, not majority control. CASH: HK$3,907.0m cash and equivalents + HK$172.3m USD short-term bank deposits at 30-Jun-2026 (no borrowings); restricted cash HK$35.3m and other financial assets at amortised cost HK$79.2m excluded. An operating-cash reserve of HK$300m (~5% of revenue) is deducted in the equity bridge because a hardware maker carrying HK$2.9bn receivables and HK$2.2bn inventory needs float. VINTAGE: FY0 is FY2025 (base revenue HK$5,872.5m); the balance sheet is 30-Jun-2026, which already absorbs the H1 FY2026 inventory build (inventory +HK$757m, H1 OCF -HK$80.5m) - so year 1 (FY2026) working-capital drag partly overlaps a cash outflow already in the bridge; immaterial at the weighted level and conservative in direction. Year 1 is discounted a full period although FY2026 is three-quarters elapsed (house end-of-year convention). MARKET READ: at HK$3.66 the market cap (~HK$3.9bn) is roughly equal to net cash, i.e. the operating business (FY2025 attributable profit HK$754m) is priced near zero EV. The model does not explain that away with a discount-rate premium; the governance/capital-return discount is surfaced in the bear weight and in valuation_philosophy.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: base-case revenue CAGR over FY2026-30 (equity_5yr_cagr 7.4% rejected - book growth is retained cash, not operating growth)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 7.4% diverges sharply from revenue (+0.8%) and diluted EPS (-3.2%): book value is compounding on retained cash (dividends cut, buybacks stopped) while the operating business shrank from the FY2022 peak (revenue HK$8.06bn -> HK$5.87bn). Equity CAGR is not used as the growth rate.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC (no equity-award taxes; interest is in investing CF). FY2020 636.1, FY2021 -10.9, FY2022 317.9, FY2023 277.0, FY2024 1,004.1, FY2025 1,241.1 (HK$m). The FCF CAGRs are dominated by working-capital swings (inventory/receivables built in FY2021-23 and released FY2024-25) and are not a growth signal; FY2024-25 FCF of 17-21% of revenue embeds that release and is NOT carried forward. SBC is too small and lumpy for the SBC-adjusted vs reported CAGR gap to mean anything here.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +9%: H1 +15.4% (USCA +52%, Japan near-doubled) against an H2 with delayed Middle East deployments and a strong H2 FY2025 comp (HK$3.16bn) -> H2 ~+4%, FY ~HK$6.40bn. Then mid-single-digit Android replacement-cycle growth fading to 3% - below the FY2017-22 run, above the FY2022-25 decline.
base.ebitda_margin_rationale: Segment EBITDA margin history 16.5/20.0/18.7/18.5/19.7/15.8/17.5% (FY2019-25), avg ~18%, includes ~0.3pp interest income. H1 FY2026 22.6% includes a HK$21m impairment reversal and lower R&D; memory-chip inflation guided to persist through H2 2026+ -> FY2026 19.5%, settling at 18.0% ex-interest.
base.capex_rationale: FY2025 capex 1.1% was a trough after the FY2021-23 Shenzhen build (4-5%); 2019-25 average 2.6%. 2.3% includes ~0.3pp ROU renewal under lease treatment A. D&A 2.0% (FY2025 2.1%, H1 FY2026 2.0%).
base.tax_rationale: Effective rate FY2025 16.9%, H1 FY2026 12.6% (HNTE 15% Shenzhen + HK 16.5% + overseas). Cash taxes paid were low in FY2025 (HK$44m, refunds) - not repeatable; 16% cash rate.
base.wc_rationale: Manufacturer with receivables + inventory far above payables: NWC ~40-50% of revenue (FY2025 ~40%; 30-Jun-2026 ~49% on annualised sales after the memory pre-buy). Growth consumes 40c of cash per HK$ of incremental revenue.

scenario_narratives.base: The Android replacement cycle in North America, Europe and Japan carries FY2026 to ~HK$6.4bn (+9%) after a strong H1, then mid-single-digit growth as MAXSTORE's 18m+ connected base slowly lifts the services tail. Memory-chip inflation squeezes gross margin through 2027 and pricing discipline only partly offsets it, so EBITDA settles at the ~18% decade average. Growth keeps consuming working capital at ~40c per incremental HK$. Cash keeps accumulating; the new management team pays modest dividends.
scenario_narratives.bull: Android migration runs longer and wider than in base: USCA (+52% in H1) compounds with a leading North American processor and World Cup-related upgrades, Japan's self-service/unattended demand keeps doubling, and LACIS recovers from its FY2025 -20%. Memory prices normalise from 2027, MAXSTORE monetisation reverses the H1 FY2026 services decline, and the opex discipline seen in H1 (R&D -17%, selling -5%) holds, lifting EBITDA to ~20.5% - roughly the FY2020 peak.
scenario_narratives.bear: Hardware commoditises: Newland, Sunmi and other Chinese peers plus Clover/Square undercut ASPs, the memory squeeze persists into 2027 without price pass-through, and the H1 FY2026 jump proves to be pull-forward (World Cup, one-off North American rollout). Revenue falls again in FY2027 as it did in FY2023-25, services/SaaS keeps shrinking (-12% in H1 FY2026), and EBITDA resets to ~15% - the FY2024 level. The new board's capital allocation stays opaque (dividend cut 68% with record cash), so the cash pile earns little for minorities.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (above the 15% default): an unhedged, acute memory-cost squeeze management says will persist, a wholesale December 2025 board/executive turnover with no track record, three years of revenue decline FY2022-25, and dividends cut sharply despite record profit and cash. Base 50%: H1 FY2026 shows the Android cycle and cost discipline are real. Bull 20% (below the 35% default): it needs several independent things at once - memory normalisation, sustained USCA/Japan growth, and a services turnaround.

valuation_philosophy.summary: PAX is valued as a cyclical hardware manufacturer with a small recurring SaaS tail, on owner FCF after a working-capital drag on growth, at a 12x terminal cap. The striking feature is the price: at HK$3.66 the market cap is roughly the HK$4.08bn of cash and deposits, so the market assigns close to zero value to a business that earned HK$754m attributable in FY2025 and HK$518m in H1 FY2026. Even the bear case values the operating business well above zero. The model therefore says the stock is cheap on flows; the honest counterweight is that the market is pricing a governance/capital-return discount (largest shareholder Hi Sun 34%, new board, dividend cut with record cash, cash largely in RMB/PRC entities) that a DCF cannot see. That discount is not hidden in a WACC premium; it is the gap between weighted IV and price, and it closes only if cash is returned.
key_risks_to_valuation: Cash accessibility: ~HK$4.1bn of cash is ~105% of market cap; if minorities never receive it (retained indefinitely, related-party use, PRC repatriation friction), most of the bridge is worth far less than book
Memory-chip cost inflation persisting beyond 2027 without price pass-through (each 1pp of EBITDA margin is ~HK$0.6/share)
Revenue lumpiness: FY2022-25 revenue fell 27%; H1 FY2026 strength may be pull-forward of large North American / World Cup orders
New management (December 2025) and Hi Sun related-party governance
Working capital: inventory rose HK$757m in H1 FY2026; an obsolescence write-down (as in FY2025) would hit both margin and cash
Services/SaaS revenue fell 12% in H1 FY2026 - the recurring-revenue thesis is not yet visible in the numbers
